insights.concise_text: PolyResponse addresses the manual ontology design and scarce annotated in-domain data challenges by using non-generative response retrieval trained on hundreds of millions of Reddit conversations with implicit semantics.

triple.subject: PolyResponse conversational search engine
triple.object: manual ontology design and scarce annotated in-domain data challenges

insights.concise_text: Because PolyResponse relies on retrieval-based design, it avoids engineering a structured ontology and dedicated decision-making policy modules that explicit-semantics task-oriented dialogue systems require.

triple.subject: retrieval-based design
triple.object: structured ontology and dedicated decision-making policy modules

insights.concise_text: The PolyResponse ranking model scores conversational replies and images by scaled cosine similarity between context encodings and candidate text or photo encodings.

triple.subject: PolyResponse ranking model
triple.object: conversational replies and images by scaled cosine similarity

insights.concise_text: The text encoder trained on more than 727M Reddit context-reply pairs produces the 512-dimensional $h_c$ and $h_r$ representations used by the PolyResponse similarity scoring.

triple.subject: more than 727M Reddit context-reply $(c,r)$ pairs
triple.object: 512-dimensional $h_c$ and $h_r$ representations

insights.concise_text: The photo encoder learned on around 200K Yelp photos and captions enables the system to score photos by whether their captions would be good responses to the current context.

triple.subject: Yelp Open dataset
triple.object: photo scoring by caption-response relevance

insights.concise_text: At inference, PolyResponse uses the Yelp dataset as the candidate pool and finds relevant text and photo responses by nearest-neighbour search over pre-computed $h_r$ and $h_p$ vectors.

triple.subject: Yelp dataset
triple.object: text and photo candidates for nearest-neighbour search

insights.concise_text: The one-shot ranking model is extended into restaurant-browsing dialogue flow by repeatedly ranking responses, aggregating their probability scores per restaurant, and narrowing the relevant restaurant set $R$.

triple.subject: one-shot ranking model
triple.object: restaurant-browsing dialogue flow

insights.concise_text: When the narrowing dialogue flow reaches only one relevant restaurant, PolyResponse displays the top $N$ responses and relevant photos, implementing the multi-modal response capability.

triple.subject: only one relevant restaurant
triple.object: display of top $N$ responses and relevant photos

insights.concise_text: The 8-language PolyResponse restaurant search is enabled by a translate-to-source approach that translates foreign response pools and user utterances into English for the English-trained encodings.

triple.subject: MT-based translate-to-source approach
triple.object: 8-language PolyResponse restaurant search

insights.concise_text: The need to reset $R$ and transfer to slot-based table booking is handled by two binary intent classifiers using the already-computed 512-dimensional $h_c$ vector.

triple.subject: two binary intent classifiers
triple.object: resetting $R$ and transferring to slot-based table booking
